data.name: BOLD: Networked Newt Action
data.detailed_description:
JUST WHEN YOU THOUGHT THE SHADOWS WERE SAFE

Inspired by the classic Spies Vs Mercs multiplayer modes that helped define 6th Generation online multiplayer, BOLD: Networked Newt Action redefines Multiplayer Stealth Action for a modern audience with the latest Unreal®️ technology. Set in an original Dark Science-Fiction-Fantasy world drawing from the classics of cyberpunk anime and cinema, starring a cast of anthropomorphic animals, BOLD pits Third Person Stealth gameplay against First Person Action in results that are often both tense and hilarious.

INFILTRATE, EXPLOIT, DOWNLOAD

As the cyberized Kobold spies of the illusive newt.displace, break into highly guarded institutions and coordinate with your partner to divide and conquer: Mercenaries are guarding objectives, which you and your partner must hack in order to succeed. You only need to capture a few points throughout the map to download the whole file, so rotate as needed to ensure your illicit surveillance and espionage remain unimpeded. Distract, stun, and disable guards and security systems using your taser, sticky cams, and concussion grenades to create holes in their defense. Navigate through the inky black of night using your Night Vision.

DEFEND THE OBJECTIVE, STOP THE LEAK

As the augmented Hund mercs of the private force OrthrosSECltd, defend vulnerability surfaces from intrusion and coordinate with your partner to stop the leak: Spies have to hack points throughout a map to download a complete file, and it is your sworn duty to prevent them from completing this before your contracted shift ends. Track and neutralize intruders using your DOGLES' Electromagnetic Vision, high caliber assault rifle, frag grenades and mines, and the building's CCTV network.

WAR IS HELL. GIVE IT ALL YOU'VE GOT.

data.short_description: BOLD: Networked Newt Action redefines multiplayer stealth action for the modern day, with a return to classic Spies vs Mercs style 2v2 asymmetrical gameplay in a dark Sci-Fi world with anthropomorphic animals. 3rd person stealth is pitted against 1st person action in maps set across exotic locales!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1660 Ti or Equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: DX11 Mode disables Nanite and Lumen, which will have performance and visual impacts.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 4070 or Equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: DX12 Mode supports Nanite, Hardware Lumen and Megalights

content_descriptors.notes: BOLD Networked Newt Action has a dark science-fiction military setting where political turmoil boils over into violence and terrorism. Gunfights occur in public locations like night clubs and trains, and combatants spurt blood (real and synthetic) when injured.
